children: Prices for fertilizers and building materials varied on Wednesday, September 23, as per the Information and Decision Support Center (IDSC).
The price of ammonium sulfate stood at EGP 20,252 per ton, marking a daily increase of 0.5%.
A ton of ammonium nitrate was priced at EGP 23,862, down 1% daily. Likewise, urea’s price declined by 1% to EGP 24,409 per ton.
As for the building materials, the price of grey cement fell by 1.6% to EGP 4,115 per ton.
Investment-grade steel amounted to EGP 38,411 per ton, rising 0.8% daily.
Ezz Steel hit EGP 39,721 per ton, down 0.1%.

title: ZAWYA: Egypt: Fertilizers, building materials varied on September 23
